verdict.rationale: Viam offers official SDKs across Python, Go, C++, TypeScript, and Flutter, with documented agent/shell usage patterns and a CLI that calls any API method, giving AI-native developers first-party programmatic access to machines. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarks or hands-on developer reviews confirming SDK quality/completeness, and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s) that would allow fully automated agent discovery of the API surface.
